## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by *Mario Bros. Deluxe U*, designed to be entertaining and friendly for players with ADHD.

## Requirements
- Build the game now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original neon-skyway platformer called STARHOP, with auto-running, collectibles, combo scoring, hazards, gaps, bounce pads, lives, dash, and a finish gate.
- Used Three.js from a CDN and added keyboard and mobile touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game and responsive title/results UI in `index.html`.
- Tested the browser experience and gameplay start; confirmed stars are collected and score/progress update without console errors.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/starhop.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further verification is needed, continue testing game controls, hazards, and completion in the browser.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/starhop.jpg`: Latest browser screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The game uses an external Three.js module at `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.

content.text:
Built **STARHOP**, a fast-paced 3D skyway platformer in `index.html`. It features auto-running, steering, jumping, dashing, star streaks, hazards, bounce pads, lives, and a finish gate, with keyboard and touch controls.

I checked the browser build, confirmed that collecting stars updates score and progress, and saved a screenshot at `screenshots/starhop.jpg`. I assumed a short, forgiving arcade run with bright visuals and simple controls.
